ops.title: desk-runner: run --desk landing gains the handoff verb the orca runner has
ops.description: Oct 20 release-v3: cutting the live landing runner (pid 29304, 0.7.172) over to 0.7.182 needed a signal because run_landing never checks stop_requested and handoff reads only the orca heartbeat. Add a landing heartbeat and stop-mark check to run_landing, and make handoff take --desk landing. Root ruling cci #104499.

ops.text: desk-runner.py handoff --config C stops a running landing runner through the stop mark after its pass (no signal), and a test in tests/test_desk_runner.py proves it
